annotations.title: Get earnings calendar by date range

description:
Returns upcoming earnings dates across all stocks for a date range.

    Serves at most 15 days per call (fromDate through fromDate+14); a longer
    range is shortened, and the result's fromDate/toDate give the window
    actually served. For a longer period, call again starting the day after
    toDate.

    Args:
        fromDate: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today)
        toDate: End date YYYY-MM-DD (default and maximum: fromDate+14)
        exchange: Optional exchange filter, e.g. 'US' for US-only results
name: get_earnings_calendar
